caption: The drawing features three distinct objects positioned with substantial empty space around them on a beige background. At the upper center, there is a diamond-shaped emblem with a beige border and a dark central circle containing the letter “W” in a decorative script, rendered in shades of gold and black. Below and to the left is a similar diamond-shaped form outlined in brown, with a beige interior featuring a geometric pattern resembling a “T” or an intersecting line, also in brown and gold colors. To the right of these two diamond shapes, there is a side view of one of the diamond emblems, showing its thickness and a support structure behind it, depicted in brown and gold. In the bottom left corner, there are two stamps or marks, one circular and pale, and the other reading "WALTON, KRAUS & METTEN," in capitalized gray letters. The drawing utilizes a limited palette dominated by beige, brown, gold, and black, with the compositional elements arranged against ample negative space.
title: Man's Stick Pin
